newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar closes near bottom of range.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar closes near bottom of range.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar closed near the bottom of its range on Wednesday after taking a peak at 71 U.S. and then retreating.
Dealers said a short U.S. market had taken the Kiwi up to its high of US$0.7095 before Asian sellers took it back down again.
It ended the session at 5.00 p.m. (0400 GMT) at 0.7073/80, little changed from its opening level. The Trade-Weighted Index gained to 67.44 from its 66.38 opening.
Dealers said that despite exporters being undercovered, the Kiwi lacked momentum to propel it higher.
"There has been a bit of selling interest and the Asian market has pushed it down to its lows," one said.
He predicted it would remain in a 0.7040-0.7110 range for the rest of the week.
